cloche.definition:
n. a low transparent cover put over young plants to protect them from cold
n. a woman's close-fitting hat that resembles a helmet
cloche.translation: n. 园艺用钟形玻璃盖, 钟形女帽

clochered.translation: (clocher 的过去时) n. (Clocher)人名；(法)克洛谢

cloches.definition:
n. a low transparent cover put over young plants to protect them from cold
n. a woman's close-fitting hat that resembles a helmet
cloches.translation: n. 园艺用钟形玻璃盖, 钟形女帽( cloche的复数形式 )

clock.definition:
n. a timepiece that shows the time of day
v. measure the time or duration of an event or action or the person who performs an action in a certain period of time
clock.translation:
n. 时钟, 计时器, (袜子上的)绣花边花
vt. 绣花样, 记时, 记录
vi. 记录时间
[计] 时钟

clock card.translation: [经] 记时卡, 上下工记时卡

clock dial.translation: 钟盘，时钟字盘，圆刻度盘; 钟面

clock glass.translation: [化] 表玻璃; 表面玻璃

clock out.translation: 用打卡机记录下班时间

clock radio.translation: n. 有定时自动开关功能的收音机, 收音机闹钟

clock tick.translation: [计] 时钟报时信号, 时间分段信号

clock watcher.translation: 老是看钟等下班的人; 盼下班的雇员

clock-maker.translation: n. 制造或修理钟表者

clock-makers.translation: (clock-maker 的复数) n. 制造或修理钟表者

clock-watcher.translation: n. 混时间的人, 老是看钟等下班的人

clock-watching.translation: [网络] 生物钟调控的关系

clocked.definition: v measure the time or duration of an event or action or the person who performs an action in a certain period of time
clocked.translation: v. 为…计时（clock的过去分词）

clockers.translation: (clocker 的复数) n. 计时员

clocking.definition: n. the time taken to traverse a measured course

clockings.definition:
plural of clocking
n. the time taken to traverse a measured course

clockless.translation: [计] 无节拍, 无时钟脉冲

clocklike.definition: a. Like a clock or like clockwork; mechanical.
clocklike.translation: a. 准时的, 有规律的

clockmaker.definition: n someone whose occupation is making or repairing clocks and watches
clockmaker.translation: n. 制造或修理钟表者

clockmakers.definition:
plural of clockmaker
n someone whose occupation is making or repairing clocks and watches
clockmakers.translation: (clockmaker 的复数) n. 制造或修理钟表者

clocks.definition:
n European weed naturalized in southwestern United States and Mexico having reddish decumbent stems with small fernlike leaves and small deep reddish-lavender flowers followed by slender fruits that stick straight up; often grown for forage
n a timepiece that shows the time of day
v measure the time or duration of an event or action or the person who performs an action in a certain period of time

clockwise.definition:
a. in the same direction as the rotating hands of a clock
r. in the direction that the hands of a clock move
clockwise.translation:
a. 顺时针方向的
adv. 顺时针方向地

clockwork.definition: n. any mechanism of geared wheels that is driven by a coiled spring; resembles the works of a mechanical clock
clockwork.translation:
n. 钟表装置, 发条装置
[电] 时钟开关

clockwork universe.translation: [网络] 机械式宇宙；机械宇宙；发条的宇宙
